newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in narrow trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended slightly lower on Tuesday after moving in a narrow range against the U.S. dollar and dealers expected more dull trade in the near term.
The local unit closed at T$27.500 against Monday's T$27.498 finish. Turnover was US$147 million.
Dealers saw some commercial demand for the U.S. dollar but said they did not expect major movements amid possible foreign equity fund inflows for the stock market.
"I think the rate will move very narrowly unless some big U.S. dollar demand emerges, which is not likely," said one. A T$27.47-52 range was seen for Wednesday. --Joyce Liu (508-0815)
